summary: Frontend-only layout verification of the ADMIN-VIEW redesign (thin host strip + fixed-height scrollable 3-col members grid) plus user-view regression and a members-API regression. METHOD: seeded 8 dummy members via POST /api/admin/members (layout_test_1..8), then connected all 8 to the LiveKit room as real remote participants from a temporary same-origin harness page that imported the bundled livekit-client ESM (harness + dummy users fully removed afterwards). RESULTS — ADMIN (Bob, 1440x850): room-admin-section height = 69.5-70 px (was ~180-200) PASS; host rendered as a single-row flex strip (display:flex, flex-direction:row, inner strip 50.5 px) with avatar 'BA', 'Bob Admin (you)', mono email, quality badge, HOST pill and state icon+label PASS. Members grid: inline gridTemplateColumns='repeat(3, minmax(0px,1fr))', gridAutoRows='120px', alignContent='start', computed overflow-y='auto' PASS. With 8 participants the container (495 px tall at 850 h) shows ALL 8 cards fully visible without scrolling (requirement was >=6) — scrolling therefore not needed at 850 h; to prove the scroll path works the viewport was reduced to 1440x700 (container 345 px, scrollHeight 384): exactly 6 cards visible above the fold, cards #7 and #8 revealed after scrolling the members container (scrollTop applied, no page-level scroll). Card content: every card exactly 120 px tall, name font-size 14 px (text-sm), names rendered in FULL (scrollWidth==clientWidth, no truncation on 'Layout Tester N'), quality badge + Mic/Mute/Kick admin buttons present on all cards; grant-mic click toggled Mic->Revoke->Mic against the backend. PTT (Space) worked for Bob (host-live-strip data-host-state speaking -> muted), my-clips trigger correctly ABSENT for admin, rank badge #1 appeared on Alice's card on Bob's screen after she spoke, PTT bar pinned at bottom (top=774 at 850 h), documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth (no horizontal scroll). USER VIEW (Alice) UNCHANGED: exactly 2 participant cards, room-participant-list inline gridAutoRows = 'minmax(0px, 1fr)' (NOT 120px) and overflow-y hidden, host rendered as a LARGE column card (165 px, admin section 184 px), my-clips popover opens (0 clips). BACKEND: /api/admin/members GET/POST/DELETE regression passes (create -> GET persistence -> username login -> delete -> gone), plan-limit 400 and duplicate-username 409 behave correctly.

issues: Because the host is muted by default the whole 1088x50 strip is filled with the solid red 'muted' card colour, producing a heavy red band directly under the header (which already shows HOST · MUTED). Consider using the state colour only for a dot/badge on the strip instead of the full background.
Cards are 353x120 with all content packed in the left half; the area to the right of the avatar row is empty. Cosmetic only.

At 1440x850 the 120 px rows leave ~100 px of empty space below the last row when there are 8 members (3 rows used out of ~4 available) — grid does not fill the container because alignContent:start; acceptable per spec but worth noting.
CARRIED OVER from iteration_12/13 (still present): Alice's own card stretches to 442 px tall with content only in the top-left corner — large empty red block. Cosmetic.

action_items: No functional blockers found — all layout requirements for this iteration verified.
Optional design: tone down the full-width red background of the host strip (use a state dot/badge instead of colouring the whole strip).
Optional design (carried over): compact the non-admin 'you' card so it doesn't stretch to 442 px.
critical_code_review_comments: renderHostStrip's quality badge had no data-testid, so participant-quality-<identity> did not exist anywhere in the admin view (the review request expected it). Added data-testid/data-quality/title to that span (only change I made to app code).
renderHostStrip duplicates ~20 lines of avatar/quality/state markup already present in renderCard — consider a shared ParticipantMeta subcomponent to avoid drift between the two renderers.
RoomPage.jsx is now ~1378 lines; the render IIFE holds renderCard + renderHostStrip + grid logic. Extract ParticipantCard / HostStrip / MembersGrid into components.

With alignContent:'start' and fixed 120 px rows the admin grid does not use the leftover vertical space; if the intent is 'fill then scroll', a minmax(120px, 1fr) auto-row would look better for 1-6 members.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://realtime-voice-hub-6.preview.emergentagent.com, room feb97dad-08c7-4de0-b28d-fabb4a85719d. To simulate MANY participants cheaply: (1) run `python /app/backend/tests/test_layout_seed.py 8` to create members + fetch LiveKit tokens into /tmp/layout_tokens.json, (2) copy /app/frontend/node_modules/livekit-client/dist/livekit-client.esm.mjs into /app/frontend/public/lktest/lk.mjs plus a connect.html exposing window.__connect(url, token) (self-contained ESM, no CDN needed), (3) open that page in a second Playwright page and connect each token (autoSubscribe:false), then join as Bob in the main page, (4) always run `python test_layout_seed.py --cleanup` and delete /app/frontend/public/lktest. Room plan A caps members at 10 (POST returns 400 'Plan limit reached'), so 8 dummies + alice + charlie is the ceiling. Fast login: goto /login -> in-page fetch /api/auth/login -> localStorage 'tn_token' -> goto /room?id=<id> -> click room-enter-button -> wait room-leave-button; stub navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with an oscillator MediaStreamDestination via add_init_script. Note browsers normalise inline gridAutoRows 'minmax(0, 1fr)' to 'minmax(0px, 1fr)' — assert accordingly.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced this iteration. The only gap found (missing participant-quality-<identity> testid inside the new renderHostStrip) was caused by the new strip being written from scratch instead of reusing renderCard's badge markup; fixed in place.
